guides.deb_step1: Download the .deb package using the button above.
guides.deb_step2: Open your file manager, navigate to Downloads, and double-click {filename}.
guides.deb_step3: Your system's Software Center (App Center / GDebi) will open automatically — click Install and enter your password.
guides.rpm_step1: Download the .rpm package using the button above.
guides.rpm_step2: Open Files, go to Downloads, and double-click {filename}.
guides.rpm_step3: GNOME Software / KDE Discover will open the package page — click Install to complete setup.
guides.appimage_step2: Right-click the file → Properties → Permissions and enable Allow executing file as program.
guides.appimage_step3: Double-click the AppImage file to run FallByte immediately.
guides.appimage_curl_comment: # Make sure curl is installed (e.g., sudo pacman -Syu --needed curl)
guides.win_step1: Download and double-click {filename} to launch the setup wizard.
guides.win_step2: Follow the on-screen prompts to finish installing FallByte.
guides.smartscreen_title: Windows Smart App Control & SmartScreen Notice
guides.smartscreen_p1: Because FallByte is a free, independent open-source project without a paid commercial EV Code-Signing certificate, Windows 11's Smart App Control may block the installer from running (or SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC").
guides.smartscreen_p2: To proceed: if SmartScreen appears, click More info → Run anyway. If Smart App Control blocks it on Windows 11, open Smart App Control settings using the shortcut below and switch it to Off.
